newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sunrise EPS views cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sunrise EPS views cut.

text.p: -- Dillon, Read & Co Inc analysts Matthew Dodds and Raul Esquivel said Friday they had reduced their estimate for Sunrise Medical Inc's fiscal year 1997 earnings per share (EPS) to $0.53 from $0.65.
-- They also cut their fiscal year 1998 EPS estimate to $0.70 from $0.85.
-- Dodds and Esquivel wrote in a report that the stock kept its outperform rating.

-- They said third quarter EPS were below expectations. "We believe that investors with time horizons in excess of one year should take a serious look at this stock ... but would warn investors with shorter time horizons that sales and earnings visibility are likely to be low over the next 12 months."
-- The company's shares closed Thursday at 10-1/4.
